Needs changes before merge: one issue with the required closing text. The code and all local checks pass.

Requested before merge:

1. Commit `1cd28a35fd24` has no `Fixes #4110` footer. The PR body has that line before `Changelog: none`, rather than at the end. Upstream main's `AGENTS.md:349`, `:355`, and `:855` require the fixing commit and PR body to end with this line. Add the footer in a follow-up commit body. Move `Fixes #4110` to the last line of the PR body. Keep the existing commit history.

Code review:

- Read the full diff and issue #4110. The panic text now names the hole-order and sinker kinds. No assertion changes.
- The Bore fixture uses `Entry3D::Plunge`. Current main already has the same field and value.
- No production code, UI, posted G-code, safety check, geometry, stock simulation, dependency, script, or golden changes. Safety mutations do not apply. Goldens moved: none.
- No earlier review or finding exists for this PR.

Local results:

Trial merge: `0963f95a32ef3f9edd7655ac02d05a87a770ea56`, with upstream main `12ea01a45eccfc5c4cd221834eeb7d3e0400f806`. The first parent is the PR head. The merge is clean.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 1 test |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test start_exit_shared` | PASS: 40 tests, 0 failed; golden checks pass |
| `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'` | PASS: all 11 light tests across 5 suites |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

Light suites: motion `lib` (7), `adaptive_troch_island` (1), `adaptive_troch_neck` (1), `adaptive_troch_parallel` (1); app `pocket_pass_start` (1). Each selected step built its test target. The broad release build step was not needed.

Extra suites run: the full `start_exit_shared` suite. No fixture directory or importer changes require other extra suites. No heavy lane was required or run. No GitHub runner was used.

The host has no `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or pool job name in its environment. `review-4157` identifies this review task.

Per the instructions for this run, I left the labels, draft state, title, and branch unchanged. The review state is `needs-rework`; I did not set that label. The review worktree and build cache remain in place.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Added follow-up commit with Fixes #4110 in its body. Moved Fixes #4110 to the last line of the PR body. Preserved the commit history. All tests and clippy pass.

merge-ready: clean full review of the new head (baf5a1c5f) against main (trial merge clean; quick gate, full start_exit_shared suite, clippy and light lane green). No blockers. Not one of our own PRs: the maintainer approves and merges by hand.
